mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, IFNULL(stats.total_count, 0) AS totalMsgCount, IFNULL(stats.account_sent, 0) AS accountSentCount, IFNULL(stats.friend_sent, 0) AS friendSentCount FROM tg_contact c INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT c2.tg_account_id FROM tg_contact c2 WHERE c2.last_send_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) OR c2.last_receive_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) ) act ON c.tg_account_id = act.tg_account_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.tg_account_id, m.chat_id, COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_outgoing = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as account_sent, SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_outgoing = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as friend_sent FROM tg_chat_message m WHERE m.chat_id >= 0 AND m.chat_id NOT IN (777000) AND m.tg_account_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT c2.tg_account_id FROM tg_contact c2 WHERE c2.last_send_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) OR c2.last_receive_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) ) GROUP BY m.tg_account_id, m.chat_id ) stats ON c.tg_account_id = stats.tg_account_id AND c.user_id = stats.chat_id WHERE (c.is_bot IS NULL OR c.is_bot = 0)
select tg_account_id as tgAccountId, phone_number as phoneNumber, username as username from tg_contact where tg_account_id in #{id}
